message:
Set the encryption level on the network thread instead of setting it on the main thread
- ensures we don't set the encryption level before the client recieved approved (existing issue) and ensure batches are flushed before the packet is sent (new issue)
Better npczones experiment

Fixed Nuclear Missile Silo terrain sometimes clipping over the doorway and underground tunnels, very fiddly to fix whilst preserving terrain auto-lowering. Tested on multiple 6000-sized maps to stress test terrain texel resolution
No longer draw ddraw objects when they attempt to parent on entities that aren't networked to the client yet
First rough pass on dogs, hacky throwable meat based on pies
Fixed an NRE every FSM tick in Trans_IsNavmeshReady when an animal entered a state that was never given an owner
Watercraft changes for the modified ocean shading.
xmas wallpapers - wip textures, materials, skin files setup. localization, updated skins list

Added support for elongated distance flares.
Fixes overly bright Floating City flares.
Fix FileStorage mistakenly caching null data when the file was not found in the DB

Fix two wearable pooling bugs introduced with 168691
- Night vision goggles getting stuck not working
- NVG scientists suit eyes not glowing after having unloaded a head on a trophy with its suit (includes a slight refactor of WearableNotifyTrophyMounted.OnMounted to support pooling)
Mesh patintables use box filtering so stencils don't look aliased and pixel-y
Make stencils menu scrollable
Bulk update of all 32 clothing prefabs items that contain skin to add the tattoo UV1
male/female body LOD updates with tattoo UVs

Water bucket viewmodel
- moved hands/fingers out in all anims to fix clipping issues with some gloves
Added tattoo stencils from concept team

Update: a couple more sprites that had meta changes
Somehow got missed in update to 26f1
Tests: editor doesn't complain

Update: automatic package upgrades
Tests: editor compiles

Add preventions for respawning on a sleeping bag which is squeezed into a gap narrower than a player, resulting in the player getting stuck on respawn
- Sleeping bags can't be placed where a player wouldn't fit
- Can't respawn on a sleeping bag in which you don't have space and would end up stuck
- Add a warning toast when placing a deployable that blocks respawning on a sleeping bag
